name: anki-workflows
description: Add reviewed, non-duplicate Anki cards directly or from macOS Reminders.

interface.shortDescription: Add reviewed cards to Anki from prompts or Reminders.
interface.longDescription: Inspect a local Anki collection, add non-duplicate cards through AnkiConnect, sync them, and optionally process learning notes from macOS Reminders.
defaultPrompt: Add these cards to my existing Anki setup without duplicates, then sync.
Review my pending language-learning Reminders, add the useful cards to Anki, and sync.
